narrative.overview: The user-supplied Proposal B is the visual authority for the root and ES/EN/CA homepages and its 33 interior pages. This supersedes the previous homepage-only Hanken Grotesk direction. The build adopts the proposal's composition, Inter typography, forest fields, tactile artwork, spacious editorial rhythm, botanical story and cream team section.
keyCharacteristics: Light, tightly tracked Inter headings against forest and white fields.
Existing tactile artwork, complete portraits, mint accents and restrained pill actions.
Scroll-linked botanical explanation with native scrolling and complete static fallbacks.
Shared page system and localized navigation across all supplied interiors.

rules.name: The Inherited Contrast Rule
rules.body: Headings inherit their section's foreground. Legacy global heading colors must not turn text dark on a forest field.

dos: Do keep replacement CSS scoped to proposal-site pages and reuse shared stylesheet paths.
Do preserve the three localized trees, public URLs, hypothetical-results disclaimer and existing service terms.
Do keep native scrolling, visible focus, complete reduced-motion/no-JS content and working contact fallbacks.
Do reuse the existing local artwork unchanged, retaining its provenance.
donts: Don't load the preview's noindex metadata, preview-domain paths or bundled animation libraries in production.
Don't reintroduce fixed desktop scroll choreography on mobile or short screens.
Don't import the old homepage's Hanken/WebGL direction into the approved proposal.
Don't restyle retained blog/article pages accidentally through unscoped replacement selectors.
